title: Pashhur Persecutes Jeremiah
description: The priest Pashhur strikes the prophet Jeremiah and puts him in the stocks at the Benjamin Gate. The next day, Jeremiah prophesies that Pashhur will be given the name Magor-Missabib (Terror on Every Side), and that he and his friends will be taken into captivity to Babylon and die there. [ref:Jer 20:1-6|Jeremiah 20:1-6]
